purpose: Broad design-only contract for external and internal context feature families considered for Phase 2 daily market phase research.

availability_ts_utc.description: Canonical point-in-time timestamp at which the row value became available to the system.

forecast_anchor_ts.description: Forecast anchor timestamp. A row is eligible only when availability_ts_utc <= forecast_anchor_ts.

availability_timestamp.validation_rule: Must be converted to UTC and compared as availability_ts_utc; rows that cannot be converted are rejected.

source_id_policy.description: source_id identifies a broad source family or approved internal context family only. It does not imply provider approval.
provider_placeholder_exclusions: No placeholder source_id may imply ingestion readiness.
No placeholder source_id may imply provider approval.
No placeholder source_id may imply modeling readiness.
No placeholder source_id may imply runtime readiness.

provider_status_values.approved_internal_context: Internal source family may be referenced as design context; no runtime materialization is authorized.
provider_status_values.design_placeholder: Candidate provider/source family is described only for future decision; provider approval is not implied.
provider_status_values.forbidden_now: Use is blocked until PM L2 changes the decision.

phase_2_usage_status_values.design_only: Permitted only in design artifacts and future validation planning.
phase_2_usage_status_values.blocked: Not permitted for ingestion, feature computation, or modeling.
phase_2_usage_status_values.future_gate_required: Requires a later PM-approved implementation/provider gate.

pit_rules: availability_ts_utc is required for every eligible feature record.
availability_ts_utc must be parseable as UTC.
D1 trade_date T is usable only from T+1 06:00 Europe/Moscow or later.
If exact release timestamp is unknown, shift by at least one trading day or exclude.
Corrected, revised, filled, or vendor-restated values cannot be joined into earlier anchors without PIT revision history.

calendar_namespace_policy.schedule_known_before_anchor: Calendar schedule data known before forecast_anchor_ts may be considered in future approved tasks.
calendar_namespace_policy.post_fact_outcome: Realized decisions, outcomes, narratives, flow estimates, or post-event explanations are denied unless a later PIT source contract permits them.
calendar_namespace_policy.phase_2_3_file_creation: No contracts/calendars/** files are created or approved by this package.

label_annotation_exclusion.rule: Labels and annotations are supervised target / research governance artifacts only and must not be used as feature evidence or source availability evidence.

source_families.availability_rule: D1 trade_date T usable only from T+1 06:00 Europe/Moscow or later.
Inherits D1 OHLC availability; EMA is context only and not a B/S/OUT label source.
Require explicit availability_ts_utc; if exact release timestamp is unresolved, shift by at least one trading day or exclude.
Provider-specific timestamp required in a later approved source contract.
Provider-specific market quote timestamp required in a later approved source contract.
Only schedule-known-before-anchor fields may be considered; post-fact outcomes are denied.
Not applicable. Raw news ingestion is forbidden now.
Not applicable. LLM classification is forbidden now.
